10: # Periodic Functions on ℕ

12: This file identifies a few functions on `ℕ` which are periodic, and also proves a lemma about
13: periodic predicates which helps determine their cardinality when filtering intervals over them.

22: theorem periodic_gcd (a : ℕ) : Periodic (gcd a) a :=

24: 
25: theorem periodic_coprime (a : ℕ) : Periodic (Coprime a) a :=
26:   fun _ ↦ eq_iff_iff.mpr coprime_add_self_right
27: 
28: theorem periodic_mod (a : ℕ) : Periodic (fun n => n % a) a :=
29:   (add_mod_right · a)

31: theorem _root_.Function.Periodic.map_mod_nat {α : Type*} {f : ℕ → α} {a : ℕ} (hf : Periodic f a) :
32:     ∀ n, f (n % a) = f n := fun n => by
33:   conv_rhs => rw [← n.mod_add_div a, mul_comm, ← Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, hf.nsmul]

39: /-- An interval of length `a` filtered over a periodic predicate of period `a` has cardinality

41: theorem filter_multiset_Ico_card_eq_of_periodic (n a : ℕ) (p : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
42:     (pp : Periodic p a) : card (filter p (Ico n (n + a))) = a.count p := by

44:     multiset_Ico_map_mod n, ← map_count_True_eq_filter_card, ← map_count_True_eq_filter_card,

46:   congr; funext n
